description: Read server readiness, live registry/store counts and retained proof summaries. status ok means health could read its sources; each retained proof names the build it measured, and only the reference-app proof says whether that is this build (thisBuild). tokens lists brands, themes and scopes from the built css-variables-by-scope.json, plus defaultScope {brand, theme, source: env|default}; this is configured default metadata, never an observed consumer scope. Missing built scopes are reported as unavailable. includeChangelog and sinceVersion select the reported DSL changelog; request-level DSL version selection is not supported. productReality.viz reports the generated taxonomy counts: types, patterns, families, classified, coreCells, coreSurfaceComplete, typedGaps and retiredCells. A surface-complete cell has public pixels from an identity assigned to that cell; Retired Core Analytics cells retain explicit reasons in the taxonomy; missing or invalid taxonomy yields null and degraded health. Each proof block also says what it was measured on (measuredOn: the release version its source declared, the source head and the archive, or null), and productReality.viz adds the census's certifiedChartTypes and certifiedScopes with the census's own measuredOn. server.uptime is milliseconds since the native server process started.

includeChangelog.description: When true, include DSL version changelog in the response.

sinceVersion.description: When provided with includeChangelog, only return changelog entries since this version.

name: health
